{{Top|leg}}
The '''battle upgrade''' was an advanced upgrade of the [[Droid fighting upgrade|fighting upgrade]] module. It provided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a library of past and present tactical engagements to draw upon as reference in order to increase efficiency in battle.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
